antenna_axial_envelope: 15 mm air/plastic from physical ESP antenna edge to inner wall

rj45_jack.note: Rev E: J1 and J2 are the identical unshielded right-angle SMD 8P8C jack, one per short board edge -- J1 (CONSOLE) opens off X=0 and J2 (MOTOR) opens off X=board_l with both mating faces FLUSH with their board edges and both jacks centred on the same Y=40 enclosure axis (straight passthrough), so the installed box reads console to motor left to right. There is no mechanical keying between console and motor; CONSOLE/MOTOR silkscreen and the cable run direction are the differentiators.

physical_gates: delivered RJ45 jack and plug latch/extraction envelope
